lesson.title: Midweek Point #1
lesson.hook: Three shots, three of your lessons, one point. A quick top-up between Saturdays.
lesson.memHTML: Step in. Middle when wide. Line when they're off it.
lesson.tomorrow: In your next match, try just one of these three on purpose, and notice how the point changes.

steps.name: Their kick second serve
steps.sit: 15–30. Their second serve is a high, heavy kick.
steps.q: Where do you stand to return it?
steps.payoff: Taken early, before it climbs: a deep return that pushes them back.
steps.why: Inside the baseline you take the kick before it kicks up, chest high, and send it back deep. Two steps back, it has climbed above your shoulder and you're too late to get there in time.

lines.A: Right: taken early. Deep, and they're pushed back.
lines.B: It climbs above your shoulder. Too late.

steps.name: Into your backhand corner
steps.sit: Their rally ball pulls you into your backhand corner.
steps.payoff: The deep middle lands every time, and all they have is a rally ball.
steps.principle: Out wide? Deep through the middle.
steps.why: The deep middle lands 10 in 10, they can only rally it, and you're in time for their next ball. The flat crosscourt stretches them and buys more time, but only 7 in 10 land.

lines.A: Right: lands every time. They can only rally it.
lines.B: More time if it lands, but only 7 in 10 do.

steps.name: They're still getting back
steps.sit: Their reply comes back. They're still getting back to the middle.
steps.payoff: Down the line goes away from where they're heading. They can only rally it.
steps.why: They're still on their way back, so the line is open: it lands 8 in 10, they can only rally it, and you're in time. Crosscourt goes back toward them, they attack it, and you're only just in time.
steps.take: They're still getting back? Down the line.

lines.A: Right: away from them. They can only rally it.
lines.B: Back toward them. They attack it.
